title: Saudi Arabian Tagine with German Twist
description: A traditional North African tagine with a German spin, featuring crunchy Saudi Arabian spices and a hint of buttery goodness.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the Saudi Arabian spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the crunchy tagine rice, buttery saffron, and Arabian dates.
Stir to combine and add the water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
